evidence: A runnable calculation on GCM output and geography's products; no model is run beyond the steady belts and the surface balances. The resort at 301 K is interpolated between the design case and the hot world's test by the ground's temperature, as climate_targets builds it, each cell's rain and each per-cell result taken across the two runs, so it mixes their two physics; the rain is taken linearly and by a constant factor a kelvin, which the two runs cannot choose between. The belts are steady Dupuit flow from each shore's water with the plants' uptake as the sink, at three transmissivities (stage 2's slow and central crust at the ground and ten times the central, sandy ground) and reaches of 15 and 25 m, on LOLA's 16 px/deg heights with the drainage product's lakes and the atlas's seas; their sub-pixel widths are a screen, which four coasts at 100 m, none in a desert, put at 1.0-2.7 times the belts resolved there, and the 100 m belts converge on one of the four. The plants' demand is FAO-56's Penman-Monteith reference surface on the GCM's own radiation, air, humidity and wind, the wind carried down from the lowest level by the CM1 rings' ratios. The night's dew and fog are an energy balance on the GCM's 3-day means, checked against its 6.5-hour means and against Earth's measured dew; ExoPlaSim itself forms no dew, since its surface flux can only raise the lowest level's humidity (fluxmod.f90, line 664). The 15 km water table is geography's on the earlier design climate's recharge. T21 resolves no coast: each cell's air is all land or all water. The slice's cost is scaled from the CM1 runs' own records; no slice is run.
reading_rule: Lengths in km, areas in km2, widths in m, heights in m above the water's level. Deserts are T21 cells whose rain at 301 K is under 0.5 mm a day, the rain taken linearly (rain_mask) or by a constant factor a kelvin (log_rain_mask), or the linear rain under the threshold that gives climate_targets' interpolated desert share (share_matched); every_cell counts all the land in such cells at 16 px/deg, model_land only the cells the GCM runs as land. Shares are of that desert land. Belt cases are named by transmissivity (slow, central, sandy) and reach; uptake is the plants' demand less the linear rain where it falls. within_reach_corrected divides each case's share by its own range of 16 px/deg over 100 m on the local coasts. Demand and dew are mm a day as time means over the whole lunar day (dew falls only at night), mm per lunar day for a lunar cycle of 29.53 days; a 301 K value is the per-cell interpolation of the two runs' own values, weighted by land area. Islands are 8-connected land bodies other than the main land, assigned to the desert by their centroid's cell. Pairs and ranges are [low, high].

forms.additive: each cell's rain moved linearly in the ground's temperature
forms.log_linear: each cell's rain moved by a constant factor for each kelvin
